get.description:
Quotes shipping cost per courier and service for a given origin, destination and package weight.

- `couriers` must be a **JSON-encoded array string** of courier codes, e.g. `["jne","jnt"]`. An empty array falls back to the platform default priority list (oexpress, jne, jnt, ninja, sap, idexpress, spx).
- `weight` is in **grams**.
- With `payment_method=cod` only COD-capable services are returned and COD fees apply.

parameters.name: origin_id
parameters.description: Origin subdistrict ID (see `/v1/subdistricts`).

parameters.name: destination_id
parameters.description: Destination subdistrict ID.

parameters.name: couriers
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of courier codes. Known codes: `oexpress`, `jne`, `jnt`, `ninja`, `sap`, `idexpress`, `spx`, `sicepat`.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Package weight in grams.

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description: Payment method of the order being quoted. Affects COD fees and which services are offered.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: JSON-encoded volumetric dimensions in cm, used for volumetric weight by couriers that support it.

parameters.name: with_fallback
parameters.description: Fall back to cached rates when a courier API is unreachable.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Quote mode. Leave at the default unless instructed otherwise.

parameters.name: exclude_couriers
parameters.description: Courier codes to exclude from `couriers`. Send as repeated `exclude_couriers[]=jne` query params.

parameters.name: origin_coordinate
parameters.description: `lat,lng` of the origin. Only used by distance-based couriers.

parameters.name: destination_coordinate
parameters.description: `lat,lng` of the destination. Only used by distance-based couriers.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Free-text marker of who requested the quote. Logged only.

parameters.name: use_cache_header
parameters.description: When true the response carries `Cache-Control: max-age=300, must-revalidate` and a `Cache-Tag` header.

200.description: Quotes retrieved. `data` is an array of courier objects (may be empty if no courier serves the route).

400.description: No courier could quote the route (e.g. subdistrict not covered). `data` is an empty string and `message` explains why.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing, invalid or expired JWT token.

422.description: Validation failed. Body is a map of field name to list of messages (Lumen default), not the standard envelope.

origin_id: The origin id field is required.

get.description:
Returns the courier tracking history and current delivery status of an order's shipment.

`submission_id` accepts three forms: the submission MongoDB ObjectId, the numeric `order_id`, or a receipt (AWB) number. A non-ObjectId value is first looked up as a receipt number and resolved to its order.

Results are scoped to the authenticated account (team members see their owner's orders); an order belonging to another account returns 404.

Tracking data is served from the stored copy when the order is already `delivered`; otherwise the courier is queried and the stored shipping status is refreshed as a side effect.

Every response is wrapped in the standard envelope: `data`, `message`, `error_code` (0 on success) and `request_id`. The HTTP status code reflects the outcome.

parameters.name: submission_id
parameters.description: Submission ObjectId, numeric order ID, or receipt (AWB) number.

parameters.name: is_return_histories
parameters.description: Include `history` and `logistic` in the response. Set false to receive only the status fields.

400.description: The order has no receipt number yet, or the courier returned an error. `data` is an empty string.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing, invalid or expired JWT token.

500.description: Unexpected error while tracking. `message` carries the exception text.

meta.description: Optional metadata as a JSON string.

request_id.description: Echo of the `X-Request-Id` header, or a generated UUID.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard envelope for a failed request. The HTTP status code carries the outcome; `data` is usually an empty string or empty array.

data.description: Empty string, empty array or null on errors.

data.description: One entry per courier that returned a quote.

code.description: Courier code. Matches the code sent in `couriers`, except J&T which is requested as `jnt` but returned as `J&T`.

service.description: Service code, as accepted by `service` on `POST /v1/orders`.

etd.description: Estimated delivery time as reported by the courier, usually in days.

insurance.description: Insurance rate config for this courier, or null when the courier has none.

source.description: Where the quote came from (e.g. `api`). Not present for every courier.

request_id.description: Echo of the `X-Request-Id` header, or a generated UUID.

history.description: Courier tracking events, oldest first. Omitted when `is_return_histories=false`.

date.description: Event time as reported by the courier (format varies per courier).

delivery_status.description: Normalised delivery status stored on the order.

receipt_number_status.description: Status recorded on the receipt number record. Usually mirrors `delivery_status`.

logistic.description: Logistic record for the order (SLA, pickup and problem-tracking data), or an empty array when none exists. Omitted when `is_return_histories=false`.

delivery_driver.description: Courier driver info when the courier provides it. Not always present.
